app.name: LivingPaper
language.label: Language
home.tagline: Chat with the characters of your books.
nav.label: Pages
settings.title: Settings
settings.lead: The language models LivingPaper talks to. You bring your own: any provider that speaks the OpenAI API will do.
settings.file.broken: The settings file {file} cannot be used: {problem}. It was not changed. Fix or remove it, then reload this page.
settings.analysisOff.title: Analysis is off
settings.analysisOff.none: No model is chosen to analyze books. Choose one below, or add one.
settings.analysisOff.unreadable: The model chosen to analyze books has a key that can no longer be read. Choose another model, or add this one again.
settings.chatOff.title: Chat is off
settings.chatOff.none: No model is chosen to chat. Choose one below, or add one.
settings.chatOff.unreadable: The model chosen to chat has a key that can no longer be read. Choose another model, or add this one again.
settings.models.title: Language models
settings.models.empty: No language model is saved yet. Add one below: LivingPaper needs one to analyze books and to chat.
settings.model.keyUnreadable: The key can no longer be read. Delete this model, then add the model again.
settings.delete.label: Delete {name}
settings.delete.warning: This deletes the model and its saved key. It cannot be undone.
settings.add.title: Add a language model
settings.add.lead: The connection is tested first, and the model is saved only if it works.
settings.add.name: Name
settings.add.nameHint: Only for you, to tell your models apart. For example OpenAI or My local model.
settings.add.baseUrlHint: The address of the API, for example https://api.openai.com/v1
settings.add.apiKeyHint: Kept encrypted on this computer and never shown again. Leave it empty for a local server that needs none.
settings.add.apiKeyAgain: For your safety the key is not kept: type the key again.
settings.add.modelHint: The name of the model as your provider writes it, for example gpt-5-nano.
settings.add.wait: The connection test can take up to a minute with a model that thinks before answering. The page waits for the answer.
settings.choose.title: Which model does what
settings.choose.lead: One model can do both. A cheaper one can read books while a better one chats.
settings.error.invalid_characters: line breaks and control characters are not allowed.
settings.error.taken: another language model already has this name.
settings.error.invalid: this is not a valid address.
settings.error.scheme: the address must start with http:// or https://.
settings.error.credentials: do not put a user name or a password in the address: use the key field.
settings.error.query_or_fragment: the address must not contain ? or #.
settings.tooMany: There are already {max} language models. Delete one before adding another.
settings.failure.unreachable: Nothing answered at this address, or too slowly. Check the address, and that the server is running.
settings.failure.keyRefused: The key was refused (HTTP {status}). Check the key and try again.
settings.failure.modelUnknown: The provider does not know this model (HTTP {status}). Check the name of the model.
settings.failure.invalidResponse: The provider answered, but not with a usable reply. Check that the address is the one of an OpenAI-compatible API.
settings.failure.providerError: The provider reported an error (HTTP {status}). Try again later.
settings.failure.promptFile: The prompts file cannot be used, so the connection could not be tested: {detail}
home.analysisOff.title: Analysis is off
home.analysisOff.body: You can still add books, but they wait: no model is chosen to analyze them. Choose one in the settings.
books.notice.added: {title} was added. It is waiting for its analysis.
books.notice.replaced: {title} replaced the earlier book of the same title.
books.unreadable.one: A stored book file could not be read and was left untouched: {names}.
books.unreadable.other: {count} stored book files could not be read and were left untouched: {names}.
books.title: My books
books.empty: No book yet. Add one below.
books.delete.label: Delete {title}
books.delete.warning: This deletes the book, its analysis and its characters. It cannot be undone.
books.add.title: Add a book
books.add.lead: An EPUB or a PDF, up to {max} MB. The book is read as soon as you send it. Its text is kept only until its analysis is finished.
books.add.fileHint: EPUB or PDF. The format is checked on the content of the file, not on its name.
books.add.titleHint: Leave it empty to use the title written in the file, or else the name of the file.
books.add.replace: Replace the book that has the same title
books.add.replaceHint: Tick it to delete that book and its analysis when the new one is added.
books.add.wait: Reading a long book can take a few seconds. The page waits for it.
books.error.empty: No file was sent. Choose an EPUB or a PDF.
books.error.tooLarge: This file is larger than {max} MB.
books.error.unsupported: This file is neither an EPUB nor a PDF. The format is checked on the content of the file, whatever its name.
books.error.scannedPdf: This PDF holds no readable text (a scanned book). Try the EPUB version.
books.error.damagedEpub: This EPUB file is damaged or incomplete, and could not be read.
books.error.damagedPdf: This PDF file is damaged or protected, and could not be read.
books.error.noText: This book holds no readable text.
books.error.duplicate: A book with this title is already there. To replace it and its analysis, tick “Replace” and send the file again.
